Getting started

Introduction

Tidewater is a small command-line tool that predicts tide times for any harbour in its database. This guide walks you through installing it and running your first query.

Installation

Download the archive for your platform and unpack it into a folder on your path. The tool has no other dependencies.

tar -xzf tidewater.tar.gz -C ~/bin

Your first query

Run the tool with the name of a harbour. It prints the next four tides with their heights in metres.

  • Use quotes around names with spaces
  • Add a date to look ahead, for example 2026-12-24
  • Pass the metric flag to force metres
OptionMeaning
DaysHow many days to show
